hypothesis: The installed Poppler+Tesseract Spanish/English CPU stack can recover three synthetic sentinels from a one-page image-only PDF after rasterization.
scope: CPU-only. No user documents, model inference, GPU, network, build, production OCR integration, model/profile/RAM/swap changes.

fixture.page: A4 1654x2339; synthetic Spanish text; 0.25 degree rotation; JPEG quality 88 embedded as image in one-page PDF

procedure: Generate synthetic scan PDF with Pillow.
Require pdfinfo to report one page and pdftotext to return no selectable text.
Rasterize page 1 at 220 dpi using pdftoppm.
Run tesseract -l spa+eng --psm 6 on raster image.
Require all three punctuation-normalized sentinels; save text, outputs, timings, hashes and result JSON.
acceptance: PASS only if one page, no selectable PDF text, successful rasterization, and all three sentinels recovered. A PASS proves only dependency/fixture viability; real-document and LlamaCode-integrated extraction remain unvalidated.
